parts.label: Absolute mirror arrival time
parts.help: Approaching mirror: r > 1, δ > 0. Include the reference camera time t₀, rather than just remaining time.

parts.label: Actual mirror height H
parts.help: Distant-object, small-angle focal-plane approximation; all quantities positive. No longitudinal contraction of the transverse height.

parts.label: Apparent virtual-image distance
parts.help: Small reflected angles; r > 1, c > 0, δ > 0. Use the reflected-ray back-traced image, not twice the mirror’s present distance.
